svg.title: Open ETF Agent six-layer module responsibility matrix
svg.desc: L1 CLI: Task entry; Offline demo / explicit submit. L1 Research Project: Import and submit research; Owned sources, frozen task. L1 Schedule: Finite once schedule; Not a resident scheduler. L2 Session: Preserve original Run; No identity / budget reset. L2 Conversation: Clarify and continue; Received ≠ adopted. L2 Temporal: Pin task time; Zone anchor, not market calendar. L2 Context: Project this turn’s input; Do not rewrite originals. L2 Compaction: Compact working context; Notes are not source evidence. L2 Memory: Explicit save and forget; Separate cross-task authority. L2 Human Interaction: Ask, receive and adopt; Explicit resume, not approval engine. L2 Specialist Profile: Freeze specialist profiles; Inherit original task boundaries. L2 Skill: Load task methods; Instructions add no authority. L3 Worker: Resume original work; Supported checkpoints only. L3 Admission: Admission and capacity; Queue, do not expand concurrency. L3 Gateway: Encode / receive model actions; Incomplete response is not action. L3 Runtime: Drive the same tool loop; Do not replay unknown dispatch. L3 Hooks: Execution hooks; Original control plane applies. L3 Run Control: Continue or stop decision; Host stop ≠ user cancellation. L3 Main → Child: Delegate, inspect, cancel; Original Session / Root budget. L3 Child Lifecycle: Independent child lifecycle; Late-result fence / cold recovery. L4 Tool Host: Check authority, then execute; Argument, path and source bounds. L4 MCP: Connect external tools; Connection is not blanket authority. L4 Trusted Plugin: Trusted local extension; Not a JavaScript sandbox. L4 Web Acquisition: Acquire public static pages; No browser rendering or crawler. L4 PDF: Retain file, extract text; No OCR / visual table parsing. L4 Result / ResultRef: Originals and exact references; Source version ≠ selection. L4 Retrieval: Find and reread sources; Search hit ≠ acquired original. L4 Knowledge: Material and source checks; Semantic quality has separate evidence. L4 Calculation: Recompute selected inputs; Not market data or trading. L4 Child Results: Return sources and advice; Advice is not original evidence. L5 Main → Report: Consume sources, save report; Completion claims need receipts. L5 Report: Compose source-linked report; Readable ≠ financially accurate. L5 Artifact / Revision: Save immutable revisions; File exists ≠ published answer. L5 Publication: Accept answer body; Original revision and commit receipt. L5 Report Review: Review frozen report text; Advisory review, not certification. L6 Loopback Reader: Read reports and attachments; Local HTTP, not full Web UI. L6 CLI Readback: Inspect original task by identity; No browser qualification claim

g.text: Open ETF Agent · v0.30.0 | Six responsibilities × module status
Module-level ownership: task identity, durable execution, Main / Child, tool boundaries, original evidence and delivery readback.
Light = bounded public implementation Purple fill + version badge = this release’s enhancement Empty = no mapped role, not a completion score.

a.text: Local HTTP, not full Web UI

g.text: Scope: dashed cards are owner call-sites, not extra modules. Empty cells are not missing features. Interactive cards open articles; source and qualification stay in the text index.
Not claimed: full product Web UI / browser qualification, resident recurring scheduling, isolated Python, PDF OCR, live financial data or production certification.
